coverage.note: The second item is an opening in San Carlos, which is not San Francisco. The Bi-Rite story's other apparent address, "50 California", is a false hit on the sentence about working with more than 50 California farms.

findings.description: Bi-Rite, a San Francisco grocery business trading since 1940, is preparing to open a market in this building — its first in the Richmond District. The report rests on an alcoholic beverage licence filing; no opening date has been announced.

extra.evidence: California Department of Alcoholic Beverage Control licence filing
